Minnesota finished: FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED on SERVICE, reported to the Captain immediately rather than held to the end of shift. All nine counters measure ZERO and the family still fails - the defect is a false statement in participant-instructions.md about EXP104's own printed page. The guide says three service boxes are marked (Required) and names MN DHS/Office of Inspector General as one of them; six are marked (Required) and DHS/OIG (box 9) is not one, it is '(check box & use if related to your case)'. The guide's follow-on sentence therefore makes boxes 3, 4, 5 and 6 - including the County Attorney's Office, the prosecuting authority - read as optional. Second limb: the County Attorney's Office is labelled 'Service list box 8' in both the blanks record and the guide, but it is box 4 on the form; box 8 is the City Attorney's Office, and the City Attorney field is ALSO labelled box 8, so box 4 is named nowhere. The two builder claims I was asked to recheck both hold: the disclosure list is in correct numeric order (item 16 last, not sorted above item 10), and the delivered page order matches the manifest across all 25 pages, confirmed from each page's own printed footer. The queue-versus-records strategy disagreement is real and recorded on both sides without reconciliation.

Illinois finished: PASS_COMPLETE_INDEPENDENT. All four route elections verified on the page by comparing each tick's x against the x of the form's own empty-box glyph - item 1 Yes, item 12 No, Section 8 (qualified probation, five years), outcome code QP, which the form's own legend on that page defines. All 45 declared writes located in the bytes; the proposed Order carries no tick anywhere, matching its printed instruction that the judge checks the boxes. Near-clone question answered WITHOUT reading the two sibling families, on which this lane holds no claim: measured from my own 13 pages plus MASTER_QUEUE, 4 pages carry route-distinguishing ink and 9 do not. Eight IL families bind the identical four-form EXP-AD set, so near-identity is structural - Illinois publishes one statewide set for both expungement and sealing. The closer pair worth a reader's attention is qualprob versus supervision, which differ by one tick position and a two-letter outcome code printed on adjacent lines of the same legend. Fee figures were grounded in the committed track registry rather than accepted. The bytes-moved flag resolves clean: the admitted RASTER_PASS pins the exact bytes I read.

The finding is unchanged and was re-verified before the edit: I reopened the pikepdf-decrypted official binary, enumerated all 14 terminal widgets with their rects, and tested for an indexed row group three ways - by name stem, by shared x and width, and by regular y spacing. Three candidates surface and all three dispose affirmatively. Mailing Address 1 and 2 are one address on two lines, stacked in the signature block, and BOTH carry ink in the delivered canonical, so even read as a two-row group it is complete. The five widgets sharing x=328.6 and width 251.6 are a stacked contact block of differently labelled facts, not indexed instances of a row schema. No widget name carries a row index. The original row already contained the contradiction this amendment fixes: it scored incompleteRows as a MEASURED 0 on exactly this reasoning while calling the obligation unmeasurable. Nothing else in the row changed - no other obligation, no counter, no digest, no verdict.
